author: Warnakulaarachchi
description: Human-readable descriptions and advice for each model feature, keyed by feature name. Used by explanation_generator.py to enrich SHAP output.

risk_score.description: Overall calculated risk score based on weighted academic and financial factors
risk_score.high_risk_advice: Your composite risk score is high. Seek immediate academic and financial counseling.
risk_score.low_risk_advice: Your risk score is healthy. Maintain current habits to stay on track.

success_rate_sem2.description: Ratio of approved to enrolled curricular units in the 2nd semester
success_rate_sem2.high_risk_advice: Low 2nd semester success rate is a strong dropout predictor. Meet with your advisor immediately.
success_rate_sem2.low_risk_advice: High 2nd semester success rate is a strong protective factor. Keep up the good work.

failure_rate_sem2.description: Proportion of enrolled 2nd semester units that resulted in failure
failure_rate_sem2.high_risk_advice: High failure rate in 2nd semester significantly raises dropout risk. Enroll in supplemental instruction.
failure_rate_sem2.low_risk_advice: Low failure rate indicates solid academic performance this semester.

academic_performance_score.description: Composite score combining semester grades, approvals, and progression
academic_performance_score.high_risk_advice: Academic performance score is low. Focus on improving grades and reducing failed units.
academic_performance_score.low_risk_advice: Strong academic performance score. Continue your current study strategy.

Curricular units 2nd sem (approved).description: Number of curricular units approved in the 2nd semester
Curricular units 2nd sem (approved).high_risk_advice: Few units approved in 2nd semester. Consider reducing your course load or seeking tutoring.
Curricular units 2nd sem (approved).low_risk_advice: Good number of units approved in 2nd semester. Indicative of solid progression.

failure_rate_sem1.description: Proportion of enrolled 1st semester units that resulted in failure
failure_rate_sem1.high_risk_advice: High 1st semester failure rate suggests early academic difficulties. Contact your advisor.
failure_rate_sem1.low_risk_advice: Low 1st semester failure rate is a positive sign of academic adaptation.

success_rate_sem1.description: Ratio of approved to enrolled curricular units in the 1st semester
success_rate_sem1.high_risk_advice: Low 1st semester success rate may indicate difficulty adjusting to university. Seek academic support.
success_rate_sem1.low_risk_advice: Strong 1st semester success rate is a positive indicator of academic readiness.

Tuition fees up to date.description: Whether the student's tuition fees are currently paid up to date (1=Yes, 0=No)
Tuition fees up to date.high_risk_advice: Tuition fees are not up to date. Visit the Financial Aid Office immediately to avoid suspension.
Tuition fees up to date.low_risk_advice: Tuition fees are paid — this is a significant protective factor.

Curricular units 1st sem (approved).description: Number of curricular units approved in the 1st semester
Curricular units 1st sem (approved).high_risk_advice: Few units approved in 1st semester. Early intervention is recommended.
Curricular units 1st sem (approved).low_risk_advice: Good unit approval rate in 1st semester shows academic stability.

Curricular units 2nd sem (grade).description: Average grade of curricular units in the 2nd semester
Curricular units 2nd sem (grade).high_risk_advice: Low 2nd semester grade average may indicate academic difficulty. Seek tutoring support.
Curricular units 2nd sem (grade).low_risk_advice: High average grade in 2nd semester strongly reduces dropout risk.

family_support.description: Composite measure of family educational background and support (parents education levels)
family_support.high_risk_advice: Lower family support levels may mean fewer resources at home. University services can help.
family_support.low_risk_advice: Higher family support is a protective factor contributing to academic resilience.

Curricular units 1st sem (grade).description: Average grade of curricular units in the 1st semester
Curricular units 1st sem (grade).high_risk_advice: Low 1st semester grades indicate potential academic difficulty ahead.
Curricular units 1st sem (grade).low_risk_advice: Good 1st semester grades are a positive predictor of eventual graduation.

Age at enrollment.description: Age of the student at the time of enrollment
Age at enrollment.high_risk_advice: Older enrollment age can present additional challenges (work, family). Seek work-study support.
Age at enrollment.low_risk_advice: Enrollment age is within typical range for this student population.

Mother's occupation.description: Coded occupational category of the student's mother
Mother's occupation.high_risk_advice: Socioeconomic background may limit access to support networks. Explore university assistance programs.
Mother's occupation.low_risk_advice: Occupational background indicates adequate socioeconomic context.

Course.description: Enrolled program or course of study
Course.high_risk_advice: Some courses have higher historical dropout rates. Speak to your program coordinator.
Course.low_risk_advice: Your course has a strong graduation completion rate — a positive baseline.

grade_improvement.description: Difference in average grades between 1st and 2nd semesters (positive = improving)
grade_improvement.high_risk_advice: Grade improvement is negative — performance is declining. Immediate academic support is advised.
grade_improvement.low_risk_advice: Positive grade improvement shows you are adapting and growing academically.

Unemployment rate.description: National or regional unemployment rate at time of enrollment
Unemployment rate.high_risk_advice: High unemployment may affect motivation and financial stability. Career counseling may help.
Unemployment rate.low_risk_advice: Current economic environment is relatively stable for post-graduation prospects.

parents_education.description: Composite score reflecting the highest qualification achieved by either parent
parents_education.high_risk_advice: Lower parental education levels correlate with reduced support at home. Use campus resources.
parents_education.low_risk_advice: Higher parental education is associated with better academic guidance and support.

Inflation rate.description: National inflation rate at time of enrollment
Inflation rate.high_risk_advice: High inflation may increase financial pressure on students and families.
Inflation rate.low_risk_advice: Stable inflation rate reduces macroeconomic pressure on your studies.

Father's occupation.description: Coded occupational category of the student's father
Father's occupation.high_risk_advice: Socioeconomic background may affect available support. University assistance programs can help.
Father's occupation.low_risk_advice: Occupational background indicates adequate socioeconomic context.

Curricular units 2nd sem (evaluations).description: Number of evaluations (assessments) in 2nd semester curricular units
Curricular units 2nd sem (evaluations).high_risk_advice: High number of evaluations with poor outcomes increases risk. Seek assessment preparation support.

Curricular units 1st sem (evaluations).description: Number of evaluations (assessments) in 1st semester curricular units
Curricular units 1st sem (evaluations).high_risk_advice: Assessment engagement was low in 1st semester — a risk indicator for dropout.
Curricular units 1st sem (evaluations).low_risk_advice: Good assessment engagement in 1st semester indicates active course participation.

Father's qualification.description: Highest educational qualification achieved by the student's father
Father's qualification.high_risk_advice: Lower parental qualification may mean reduced academic guidance at home.
Father's qualification.low_risk_advice: Parental qualification indicates a positive educational background.

Mother's qualification.description: Highest educational qualification achieved by the student's mother
Mother's qualification.high_risk_advice: Lower maternal qualification may mean reduced academic guidance at home.
Mother's qualification.low_risk_advice: Maternal qualification indicates a positive educational background.

total_workload.description: Total number of curricular units enrolled across both semesters
total_workload.high_risk_advice: Very high workload relative to performance increases dropout risk. Consider reducing course load.
total_workload.low_risk_advice: Workload is well-managed given your performance level.

Curricular units 2nd sem (enrolled).description: Number of curricular units enrolled in the 2nd semester
Curricular units 2nd sem (enrolled).high_risk_advice: Heavy enrolment with poor performance is a risk factor. Review your course load with an advisor.
Curricular units 2nd sem (enrolled).low_risk_advice: Unit enrolment is appropriate for your performance level.

Application mode.description: Mode through which the student applied (e.g., general, special, transfer)
Application mode.high_risk_advice: Some application modes are associated with higher adjustment challenges. Seek orientation support.
Application mode.low_risk_advice: Your application pathway shows standard entry characteristics.

Scholarship holder.description: Whether the student holds an active scholarship (1=Yes, 0=No)
Scholarship holder.high_risk_advice: Not holding a scholarship removes a key financial safety net. Explore scholarship opportunities.
Scholarship holder.low_risk_advice: Active scholarship is a significant protective financial factor.

Application order.description: Order of course preference in the application (1 = first choice)
Application order.high_risk_advice: Low application order preference may indicate course misalignment. Speak to a career advisor.
Application order.low_risk_advice: Being enrolled in your first-choice course is positively associated with motivation.

Curricular units 1st sem (enrolled).description: Number of curricular units enrolled in the 1st semester
Curricular units 1st sem (enrolled).high_risk_advice: Heavy 1st semester enrolment with weak results is a risk factor.
Curricular units 1st sem (enrolled).low_risk_advice: Unit enrolment in 1st semester is appropriate.

Displaced.description: Whether the student is a displaced person (1=Yes, 0=No)
Displaced.high_risk_advice: Being displaced may present social and financial challenges. University social services can assist.
Displaced.low_risk_advice: Not displaced — reduces certain social risk factors.

Gender.high_risk_advice: Gender-specific dropout patterns exist; targeted support programs are available.
Gender.low_risk_advice: Gender is not a primary driver in your risk profile.

credits_utilization_sem1.description: Ratio of credited units to enrolled units in 1st semester
credits_utilization_sem1.high_risk_advice: Low credit utilisation in 1st semester may indicate unit withdrawal or failure.
credits_utilization_sem1.low_risk_advice: Credit utilisation is healthy for 1st semester.

Curricular units 1st sem (credited).description: Number of credited (transferred/exempted) curricular units in 1st semester
Curricular units 1st sem (credited).high_risk_advice: Review whether credited units are being properly acknowledged.
Curricular units 1st sem (credited).low_risk_advice: Credit transfers are recognised and integrated into your academic plan.

credits_utilization_sem2.description: Ratio of credited units to enrolled units in 2nd semester
credits_utilization_sem2.high_risk_advice: Low credit utilisation in 2nd semester. Check your unit status with your program coordinator.
credits_utilization_sem2.low_risk_advice: Credit utilisation is healthy for 2nd semester.

age_group_21-25.description: Indicator: student age falls in the 21-25 range at enrollment
age_group_21-25.high_risk_advice: Age group 21-25 can face competing priorities. Work-study balance support is available.
age_group_21-25.low_risk_advice: Age group does not elevate risk in your specific profile.

Debtor.description: Whether the student has an outstanding debt to the institution (1=Yes, 0=No)
Debtor.high_risk_advice: Having debt to the institution is a significant financial risk factor. Contact the Bursar's Office today.
Debtor.low_risk_advice: No outstanding debt — this is a positive financial indicator.

Previous qualification.description: Highest level of education completed prior to enrollment
Previous qualification.high_risk_advice: Lower prior qualification may mean a steeper academic adjustment curve.
Previous qualification.low_risk_advice: Prior qualification level indicates adequate academic preparation.

Curricular units 2nd sem (credited).description: Number of credited (transferred/exempted) curricular units in 2nd semester
Curricular units 2nd sem (credited).high_risk_advice: Review whether 2nd semester credited units are properly recorded.
Curricular units 2nd sem (credited).low_risk_advice: Credit transfers are recognised for 2nd semester.

Marital status.high_risk_advice: Marital status may introduce additional responsibilities affecting study time.
Marital status.low_risk_advice: Marital status is not a primary risk driver in your profile.

Curricular units 1st sem (without evalua.description: Number of 1st semester units with no evaluation recorded
Curricular units 1st sem (without evalua.high_risk_advice: Units without evaluations in 1st semester may indicate disengagement or withdrawal.
Curricular units 1st sem (without evalua.low_risk_advice: All enrolled 1st semester units have assessments — good engagement indicator.

age_group_30+.description: Indicator: student age is 30 or older at enrollment
age_group_30+.high_risk_advice: Mature-age students often face work and family commitments. Flexible study options are available.
age_group_30+.low_risk_advice: Age group does not elevate risk in your specific profile.

age_group_26-30.description: Indicator: student age falls in the 26-30 range at enrollment
age_group_26-30.high_risk_advice: Mid-career enrollment can involve competing responsibilities. Seek work-life balance support.
age_group_26-30.low_risk_advice: Age group does not elevate risk in your specific profile.

Curricular units 2nd sem (without evalua.description: Number of 2nd semester units with no evaluation recorded
Curricular units 2nd sem (without evalua.high_risk_advice: Units without evaluations in 2nd semester are a strong disengagement signal. Act now.
Curricular units 2nd sem (without evalua.low_risk_advice: All enrolled 2nd semester units have assessments — good engagement indicator.

Daytime/evening attendance.description: Whether the student attends daytime or evening classes
Daytime/evening attendance.high_risk_advice: Attendance mode may indicate work or other commitments competing with studies.
Daytime/evening attendance.low_risk_advice: Attendance mode is appropriate for your current profile.

International.description: Whether the student is an international student (1=Yes, 0=No)
International.high_risk_advice: International students may face additional challenges. International student support services can assist.
International.low_risk_advice: Not flagged as international — reduces certain administrative and cultural risk factors.

Nacionality.high_risk_advice: Some nationalities face additional administrative or language barriers. Support services are available.
Nacionality.low_risk_advice: Nationality is not a primary risk driver in your profile.

Educational special needs.description: Whether the student has registered educational special needs (1=Yes, 0=No)
Educational special needs.high_risk_advice: Ensure that your special educational needs accommodations are in place. Contact the Disability Office.
Educational special needs.low_risk_advice: No special educational needs on file — standard academic support applies.
